tags.carmen_f_1: [dryly] The burglar. [pause] [amused] You look terrible. Sit. I'm making coffee. [deadpan] That's not kindness, I want one.
tags.carmen_su_elena: [warmly, remembering] She laughed at everything. She drew everything. She left her socks in the bath for eight years. [pause] [voice breaking] We were going to buy a house in Artenara. Above the cloud.
tags.carmen_lr_water: [urgent, raising her voice over the engine] Water. On the radiator. Now, before she cracks. [frustrated] I'm not stopping in this cloud.
